name: Bills of materials
summary: Bills of materials: keeps each product's list of components and quantities in the business's own system. Drafts a new bill for each product on the owner's list, checks that its components are active and in stock, and queues any change to a live bill for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every change to a live bill.

all.evidence: 1 of 4 calls read describes how a manufacturer builds its bills (concrete batching)

covered_by.unit-of-measure: skill (each product's own unit, confirmed by a person)
covered_by.version-control: approval (a change to a live bill is queued)

crons.name: check
crons.summary: Hourly: read each bill the workflow created, bring its record in step with Unleashed, and note any component with less stock than one unit needs. Reads only.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Every 30 minutes: create the bill in Unleashed for each product on the owner's list that has none yet. Internal record only.

crons.name: revise
crons.summary: Daily (22:15 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia): queue a change to a live bill when the owner's list differs from it. A person approves it.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads, and one internal record: a new bill of materials in Unleashed, which is not an assembly or an order and reaches no customer or supplier. Changing a live bill waits for a person.

unleashed.covers: product lookup by code, bill read and create, stock on hand, bill revision (queued for approval)

gaps: Unleashed: core/sdk signs every call (api-auth-id, api-auth-signature, client-type from the UNLEASHED_* keys). Tested offline against a fake network only; no live reply has been seen.
Acumatica: no operations mapped in the kit and its help pages describe no API calls. Covered by skill steps only.
Odoo: the kit holds one operation (docs.get_web_version), so the bill of materials model has no mapped operations. Its forum pages describe the BoM form and export only. Covered by skill steps only.
Design drawings or CAD import: no platform evidence. Skill step only.
Supplier part matching, costing roll-up, routing and work centres, production orders (Assemblies), change handover and sign-off: not described as a bill step by the Unleashed pages. Left to people.
Units of measure: each bill line takes the product's own unit. The workflow does not convert units.
The capabilities list in core/capabilities.json has no bill-of-materials entry. The bill operations are named in workflow.json only.
Evidence is one discovery call. Confirm the shape with a second call before a client build.
No Unleashed sandbox account yet. Field names come from the vendor's API reference, not from a live reply; the create and update body must be checked on a sandbox.

evidence.calls: 4 manufacturing calls read; 1 describes its way of building bills of materials (concrete batching)
evidence.platforms: Unleashed API reference (BillOfMaterials, Products, StockOnHand, UnitOfMeasures) mapped in the kit; Acumatica and Odoo help pages, no bill operations mapped
